Do ek jaisi chocolate hain: Farhan ki 7 barabar hisson mein todi gayi, Isha ki 3 mein. Dono ne apni chocolate ke 2 hisse khaye, aur dekhna hai ki kisne zyada khaya. Yahan tak theek hai?
haan
Pehle dono ke upar wale number dekho: dono mein 2, yaani dono ne do-do hisse khaye, kyunki ginti barabar hai, isliye ab sirf hisse ka size dekhna baaki hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
haan
Phir har hisse ka size likho: Farhan ka har hissa 1/7, Isha ka 1/3, kyunki Farhan ki chocolate 7 hisson mein kati hai, Isha ki usi size ki chocolate sirf 3 mein. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan, samajh aaya
Toh zyada kisne khaya, Farhan ne ya Isha ne?
director.card: Toh zyada kisne khaya, Farhan ne ya Isha ne?

director.text: Isha
Sahi jawab. Dekho, dono ne 2 hisse khaye, par Isha ke 1/3 wale hisse Farhan ke 1/7 wale hisson se bade the. Toh poora jawab: Isha ne, 2/3. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
haan, samajh aaya

Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 4/9, 4/7 aur 4/5 hai, kyunki teeno mein 4 hisse, par 1/9 ka hissa sabse chhota aur 1/5 ka sabse bada; isliye 4/9, phir 4/7, phir 4/5. Ab tak samajh aaya?
mujhe lagta hai haan

Anjali aur Imran ke paas ek jaise ribbon hain. Anjali apna ribbon 12 barabar hisson mein kaatkar 5 leti hai, aur Imran apna ribbon 6 mein kaatkar 5 leta hai. Dono apne liye hue hisse jodkar ek ribbon banate hain. Kiska ribbon lamba banega, Anjali ka ya Imran ka?

director.text: Imran hai na

Sahi jawab. Dekho, dono ke paanch-paanch hisse, par Imran ka har hissa Anjali ke hisse ka do guna hai. Do pizza hain, bilkul ek jaise. Ek ke 7 barabar hisson mein se 6 bache, doosre ke 9 mein se 8. Dono mein poore pizza se bas ek-ek hissa kam hai. Poore pizza ke zyada paas kaun hai, 6/7 ya 8/9?

director.text: eight ninths

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 8/9 mein bas 1/9 ki kami hai, 6/7 mein 1/7 ki, aur 1/9 ki kami chhoti hai. Ab poore paath ko yaad karke bas ek sawaal aur karna hai. Do ek jaisi patti hain: ek ke 10 barabar hisson mein se 7 liye, doosri ke 12 mein se 7. Kaunsa chhota hai, 7/10 ya 7/12?
12/7 sahi nahi hai. Iska jawab hai 7/12, kyunki dono se 7 hisse liye, par 12 hisson wali patti ka har hissa chhota hai, isliye 7/12 chhota hai. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe laga aisa hi hoga

Aaj ki baat yeh thi ki ek hi poore ke jitne zyada barabar hisse hon, har hissa utna chhota hota hai. Phir yeh dekha ki neeche wala number same ho toh hisse ek size ke hote hain, aur upar wala number, yaani hisson ki ginti, faisla karta hai. Aakhir mein yeh dekha ki upar wala number same ho, toh jis fraction ka neeche wala number chhota hai, uske hisse bade hote hain aur wahi zyada hota hai. Aaj ka kaam aasaan laga ya thoda mushkil?
haan, samajh aaya
Chalo, yeh baat bhi dhyaan mein rakhi. Aaj ke paath mein tumne dekha ki 6/7 aur 8/9 mein kiski kami chhoti hai. Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milenge!
